items.title: 4.3.1 Combining Stacks and Queues to Evaluate Expressions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of combining stacks and queues (PDF 118).

blocks.text: Stacks aur queues maths ke expressions hal karne ke powerful tools (taqatwar auzaar) hain, khaas taur par jab expression mein complex (pecheeda) operations hon. In dono ko mila kar hum operations ka order (kaunsa pehle ho), brackets (parentheses) aur expression ka sahi jawab achhi tarah sambhal sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Infix ko postfix mein badalte waqt stack kya rakh sakta hai aur queue kya?
blocks.explanation: Stack operators aur brackets rakhta hai; output tokens ek queue mein rakhe ja sakte hain, jinhein postfix hal karte waqt aage se parha jaye. (Yeh tareeqa computer science ki aam baat hai; kitab is ki hal ki hui misal nahi deti.)

items: Stacks aur queues mil kar expressions mein operators ka order aur brackets sambhalte hain.
